name: metadefender-cloud
description: Scan files, look up hashes, and check IP, domain, URL and CVE reputation with OPSWAT MetaDefender Cloud.
long_description: Uses your MetaDefender Cloud API key to multiscan files with 20+ engines, run Deep CDR sanitization and sandbox analysis, look up file hashes, and check IP, domain, URL and CVE reputation. Files uploaded for scanning are shared with OPSWAT unless private scanning is used (paid plans).

tools.name: lookup_hash
tools.description: Multiscan verdict for an MD5, SHA1 or SHA256 hash

tools.name: lookup_hashes_bulk
tools.description: Look up to 1000 hashes at once

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Upload a local file for multiscanning, with optional Deep CDR, sandbox or archive extraction

tools.name: get_scan_result
tools.description: Get a file scan result by data_id

tools.name: get_sanitized_file
tools.description: Get the Deep CDR sanitized file download link

tools.name: get_sandbox_report
tools.description: Get dynamic analysis results by sandbox_id or hash

tools.name: get_api_usage
tools.description: API key plan and remaining daily limits
